request.prompt:
One illustration of 9 separate characters arranged in 3 rows of 3, evenly spaced across a single seamless background.
Subject: Mickey Mouse with a big shiny golden chain around his neck, classic black ears and red shorts, consistent in every cell.
Style: glossy 3D render, smooth rounded shapes, shiny plastic-like material, soft studio lighting with bright reflections.
Outline: none. Draw every character directly on the background with no outline, border, stroke, die-cut edge or halo around it.
Reading left to right, top to bottom, each character shows a clearly different, highly expressive emotion and pose:
Character 1: Mickey grinning widely, flashing his golden chain proudly
Character 2: Mickey looking surprised, eyes wide and mouth open, holding chain tight
Character 3: Mickey laughing heartily, head thrown back with eyes closed
Character 4: Mickey sad and drooping, chain hanging limply around his neck
Character 5: Mickey angry, eyebrows furrowed, fists clenched beside his chain
Character 6: Mickey blushing shyly, looking down at his golden chain
Character 7: Mickey sleepy, eyes half-closed, chain resting quietly
Character 8: Mickey curious, tilting head with one eyebrow raised, chain gleaming
Character 9: Mickey mischievous, smirking with one eye squinting, chain swinging slyly
Make every expression big and readable at small size: exaggerated eyes, eyebrows, mouth and body language.
Consistency: the same character design, proportions and colours for all 9 characters.
Background: a single, seamless, solid pure green (#00FF00) background covering the whole image in exactly one shade, with no tiled panels, no shading variations, no tint, gradient, vignette or glow, no shadows, no floor, no noise.
Spacing: every character is full body with a generous empty margin on every side (at least 20% of its own size), clearly separated from the others, none touching or crossing another.
request.label: mickey mouse with big golden chain
